bio.jane/contract.question: How similar are these two molecules under each fingerprint?

description: How similar two small molecules are: Tanimoto under six RDKit fingerprints (Morgan/ECFP4, atom pair, topological torsion, RDKit path, pattern, MACCS), every DataStructs metric (Tanimoto, Dice, cosine, Sokal, Russell, Rogot-Goldberg, all-bit, Kulczynski, McConnaughey, asymmetric, Braun-Blanquet, on-bit, Tversky) on the chosen one, and count-based Tanimoto, Dice and Tversky on Morgan counts. The first molecule is the query.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

fingerprint.description: the fingerprint every metric is read on. Values: morgan (Morgan (ECFP4)), atomPair (Atom pair), torsion (Topological torsion), path (RDKit path), pattern (Pattern), maccs (MACCS keys).

molecule.description: the query structure: SMILES or a molfile.

other.description: the structure to compare it with: SMILES or a molfile.

tversky_a.description: Tversky's weight on bits only the query has, 0–1.

tversky_b.description: Tversky's weight on bits only the other has, 0–1.

name: compare_molecules

count_similarity.description: Tanimoto, Dice and Tversky on unfolded Morgan radius-2 counts

metrics.description: every metric on the chosen fingerprint, keyed Tanimoto, Dice, Cosine, Sokal, Russel, RogotGoldberg, AllBit, Kulczynski, McConnaughey, Asymmetric, BraunBlanquet, OnBit, Tversky

summary.description: the comparison in words, generated from this run

tanimoto_by_fingerprint.description: per fingerprint: kind, length, bits set in each molecule, bits in common, Tanimoto
